newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids remain up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids remain up.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids remained higher on Tuesday in line with gains in the Minneapolis Grain Exchange spring wheat futures, dealers said.
Business was slow as receipts were decent but farmer selling was shut off, one Minneapolis dealer said. "Farmers are waiting for higher prices," he said.
He noted that mill demand was supporting U.S. prices. Harvesting of spring wheat was pretty much completed and the quality looks good for the late planted spring wheat.
In Montana, some winter wheat seeding was sporadic, limited in some areas and normal in other locations, a dealer said.
MGE December spring wheat gained 6-1/4 cents to end at $4.19 per bushel.
